raised: The '123 מקור · 123 חושב · 123 הזנתה · מונח' row is confusing and unexplained
Unclear what counts as 'השתלמות' (training) for the 3-year withdrawal option
Unknown terms in 'כדאי להכיר גם' (קרן חדשה מקיפה, תגמולים, אישית לפיצויים)
Doesn't know what 'אג"ח ממשלתית צמודה' is
Calculator result was misleading: 17,370 ₪ looked like the total but is only net profit
The comparison leaves out the employer's money, so the 415.84 ₪ difference looks tiny and almost discouraging
The negative end of the range (₪−342.02) is confusing
'הפקדה אחרי משיכה הולכת לחשבון חדש' didn't mean much
The 'no law requires every employer to contribute' line leaves it unclear whether their employer must contribute
Company cards: the names mean nothing to them
Cost table shows only legal maximums, not the real price
'שכירים: אין ניכוי על ההפקדה שלכם' was not understood
The orange early-withdrawal warning is a bit scary and the tax-bracket part was not understood
The chief-economist note about cutting the benefit was slightly worrying
Can't find what happens if they leave the job before 6 years
Can't find what happens at 6 years if they don't withdraw
Can't find how to actually sign up or how to choose a company in simple terms
No simple total after 6 years that includes the employer's money
Would drop the grey tags, codes (TXH-09 etc.), 'חוקים וכללים' badges and the 123 row
Would drop the full glossary table (keep terms as hover links)
Would drop the 'שחקו עם המספרים שלכם' section

problems.why: The reader takes the 7.5% to be an employer deposit into the keren and never says it is unclear whether it goes to the study fund or a pension fund.
